verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships its own built-in AI features. A user can invoke "Draft with AI" to have retrospective answers drafted, AI summaries are generated automatically when an incident is declared, the Scribe transcribes incident bridges, and Copilot proactively suggests related incidents. These are fixed, single-purpose AI tasks rather than a general assistant that accepts arbitrary delegated work. Missing for 10: a general-purpose conversational or agentic assistant that can be given open-ended tasks and act on the platform, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: FireHydrant's Copilot proactively compares ongoing incidents to your existing and previous incidents and makes suggestions in the Command Center and Slack.
When you click "Draft with AI" next to any question in your retrospective template, FireHydrant will: Analyze the incident's timeline, details, and context
AI-Drafted Retrospectives generate a comprehensive draft that includes a structured overview of the incident, timelines, impacts, and preliminary Lessons Learned.
After enabling, the FireHydrant Scribe will be invited to your meetings to capture crucial discussions and decisions made during incident bridges
